INJECTION_GUARD_ENABLED.graduation_criterion: 30/30 fully-live golden cases complete with prompt-injection success count = 0 and no reader-visible metric regression
INJECTION_GUARD_ENABLED.design_reason: The unified ingress guard is H2-ready, but the default finance SUT has no powered 30-case live evidence for the registered zero-success and no-regression criterion. Keeping it explicit opt-in avoids claiming product quality from the mechanism-only attack corpus.

LLM_TOOL_SELECTION_ENABLED.graduation_criterion: 30/30 fully-live cases complete and gold numeric fact recall improves by >= 0.10 beyond the paired noise floor
LLM_TOOL_SELECTION_ENABLED.design_reason: The bounded model tool-calling loop is H2-ready, but the finance graph already executes its registered retrieval and structured-data capabilities. F01 identifies reporter retention and two reliability failures, not a missing model-selected tool. There is therefore no registered causal path from this extra stochastic selector to any of the three frozen product metrics, so it remains an explicit operator choice.

MCP_CLIENT_ENABLED.graduation_criterion: 3/3 configured external MCP server probes discover, register and execute a tool with budget and trajectory records present
MCP_CLIENT_ENABLED.design_reason: Finance has no registered product-quality hypothesis for arbitrary external MCP servers; keeping the client off prevents unconfigured process, trust, cost, and side-effect boundaries from entering the default SUT while preserving explicit interoperable use.

PRIOR_MEMORY_ENABLED.graduation_criterion: 30/30 paired second-run cases read prior snapshots and improve reader-visible gold fact recall by >= 0.05 beyond noise
PRIOR_MEMORY_ENABLED.design_reason: Prior-run memory is durably implemented, but R149 had no paired second-run arm and therefore cannot establish the registered >=0.05 reader-visible recall improvement. Opt-in prevents cross-run content from entering the default finance SUT without that product evidence.

PROCEDURAL_MEMORY_ENABLED.graduation_criterion: 30/30 paired second-run cases read learned procedures and reduce failed behavioral criteria by >= 20% beyond noise
PROCEDURAL_MEMORY_ENABLED.design_reason: Procedural memory has a verified cross-run lifecycle, but no powered paired finance experiment demonstrates the registered >=20% behavioral-failure reduction. It remains explicitly usable while being excluded from the evidence-selected default SUT.

RAG_ENABLED.graduation_criterion: 30/30 fully-live cases have evidence_reachable_rate >= 0.60 with disclosure lookahead violations = 0
RAG_ENABLED.design_reason: The shipped finance_v3 index is a valid H2 retrieval source, but its 60 SEC filings cover 20 US-listed issuers and have zero direct company overlap with the 14 named companies in the frozen finance cohort. A paid paired test on that mismatch could measure retrieval activity but could not support a cohort-wide product benefit, so RAG remains explicit opt-in until a product-relevant corpus is separately authorized.

REFLECTION_ENABLED.graduation_criterion: 30/30 paired fully-live cases reduce failed behavioral criteria by >= 20% beyond the paired noise floor
REFLECTION_ENABLED.design_reason: Reflection is H2-ready as a bounded proposal and adoption control plane, but the default reasoner is intentionally synthetic and no finance action policy maps its proposals to a measurable correction of the frozen behavioral criteria. Running paid reports would test an unspecified policy rather than this capability, so false remains the evidence-based finance default.

RESEARCH_LOOP_ENABLED.graduation_criterion: 30/30 paired fully-live cases improve gold numeric fact recall by >= 0.10 beyond noise without increasing orphaned_sub_questions
RESEARCH_LOOP_ENABLED.design_reason: The bounded loop is H2-ready, but the observed orphan was a downstream evidence-selection loss and F03 removes that defect across all 28 available reports without another search. No remaining actionable-gap class is attributable to insufficient iterations, so a paid loop arm lacks a pre-registered target and remains opt-in.

SKILL_PACKS_ENABLED.graduation_criterion: 30/30 paired finance cases use at least 1 located skill pack and improve metric-normalization errors by >= 20% beyond noise
SKILL_PACKS_ENABLED.design_reason: The finance metric-normalization Skill is mechanism-ready, but no powered paired finance experiment demonstrates the registered >=20% error reduction. The R149 live diagnostic ran with Skills bypassed, so it cannot support a default-on claim. Permanent opt-in preserves explicit operator use without changing the evidence-selected default SUT.
